metadata.description: Open-source plugins, skills, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools
plugins.description: Codex Chrome DevTools plugin with route sessions, upstream MCP delegation, live evidence bundles, API discovery, redacted cURL, performance workflows, and sync guardrails.

plugins.name: decodo
plugins.description: Decodo scraping, proxy, MCP, and SDK workflows for Codex.

plugins.name: envato-r2
plugins.description: Search Envato with a user-owned browser session, download licensed assets, and save them to Cloudflare R2.

plugins.name: infographic-docs
plugins.description: Multi-page HTML explainer/guide generator. Builds styled, multi-tab HTML docs into the knowledge-base, creates last-30-days community pulse docs, routes optional external tools, previews through Playwright MCP, renders diagrams/charts, and registers docs in the library index.

plugins.name: laws-of-ux
plugins.description: Audits a frontend project against the 30 Laws of UX (lawsofux.com). Detects the UI stack, scores each applicable law from concrete source-code signals, and produces a graded report (0-100 + A-F) with a findings table, a coverage band, and a prioritized quick-wins-vs-larger-efforts fix list. Static by default; an optional --url pass measures the running app. Read-only unless you run /ux-fix.

plugins.name: mcp-app-builder
plugins.description: Create, package, connect, and verify ready-to-use MCP Apps for Codex plugins.

plugins.name: mermaid-png
plugins.description: Render Mermaid 11.16 diagrams from pasted text or .mmd files to PNG or SVG images.

plugins.name: supabase-fullstack
plugins.description: Connector-aware Supabase command surface for live project access, SQL, migrations, advisors, logs, branches, Edge Functions, RLS, Auth, Storage, Postgres performance, and local project conventions.

plugins.name: tool-finder
plugins.description: Find, compare, improve, self-check, and plan installation for agent tools across callable Codex tools, connector plugins, local inventory, live GitHub, Hugging Face, skills.sh, npm, Python, Homebrew, and deferred package registries.

plugins.name: universal-debugger
plugins.description: Cross-codebase debugging orchestration for routing failures, bug hunts, adjacent defect sweeps, and evidence-backed fixes.

plugins.name: vintone-studio
plugins.description: Codex planning and runbook plugin for safe VINTONE Photoshop editing workflows.
